title: Converge the 13 pagination normalizers and the 6-8 sort whitelist helpers onto the shared helpers
goal: Thirteen pagination normalizers and six to eight sort whitelist helpers do the same two things: clamp page and pageSize, and map a requested column to an allowed one or fall back to the default. Each keeps its own defaults, caps and column list, which is correct, but the code that applies them is copied. This wave replaces the copies with the shared helpers while passing each module's own values in as parameters, and merges the two copies that exist inside role_helper.go. The measurable outcome is one pagination implementation and one sort implementation, with the per-module caps and whitelists unchanged and every boundary case covered by a test.
findings: RC-013 (P1): normalizers at role_helper.go:523-539 and :541-557 (two in one module), post_service.go:690-706, permission_service.go:963-979, user_helper.go:29-48, dict_service.go:1339, audit_service.go:378, security_service.go:722, login_service.go, session_service.go:460, tenant_ops_view.go:390, tenant_handler.go:276, tenant_platform_handler.go:187, setting_audit.go:162. Offset/Limit call sites at role_service.go:134,766; post_service.go:97; permission_service.go:226; user_service.go:266; dict_service.go:602; audit_service.go:96; security_service.go:229; session_service.go:504; setting_audit.go:180; login_service.go:286; tenant_ops_view.go:437; tenant_service.go:1005,1039.

RC-015 (P1): sort whitelist helpers at role_helper.go:559+, post_service.go:708+, permission_service.go:984+, user_helper.go:50+, menu_service.go:597-630, plus dept, dict, audit and security variants.
RC-028 (P2): setting_audit.go:162 carries its own inline pagination.

in: Merge the two role_helper.go normalizers into one and then onto the shared helper
Replace each module normalizer with the shared helper, passing that module's default page size and cap
Replace each sort helper with the shared helper, passing that module's allowed-column map and default column
Replace the 14 Offset/Limit sites with the offset returned by the helper
Add boundary tests: page 0, page negative, pageSize 0, pageSize above cap, unknown sort column
out: Changing any module's default page size, maximum page size or default sort column
Changing the JSON list response shape, total counting or empty-list behaviour
Adding cursor pagination or any new pagination mode
Touching GORM query construction beyond the Offset/Limit values

implementationNotes: Capture each module's current default and cap before replacing it. If two modules genuinely disagree, that disagreement is preserved, not harmonised.
The two role_helper.go copies may differ in edge-case handling; diff them first. If they do differ, the merged version must adopt the behaviour of the one actually called at each site.
Replace the normalizer and the Offset/Limit site in the same commit for a given module, otherwise the intermediate tree can page differently.
If a module's normalizer also sanitises something else (for example keyword trimming), keep that part local.
Do not change tenant-service queries in this wave if W9 will rewrite them; coordinate by leaving tenant_service.go:1005,1039 to W9 and noting it in the summary.
